personal.summary: I'm an SQA Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, REST API testing, and performance/load testing across enterprise and government-facing systems. I also build Python-based test tooling and bulk data-processing automation — work that's helped me catch data-integrity and reconciliation issues that automated pipelines alone tend to miss. Outside of work, I'm building deeper automation skills through self-directed projects in Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium/TestNG, and currently expanding into SQL, TypeScript, and CI/CD with Docker.
